Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.
2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.0771 of 2023, under Section 498A, 304B IPC & Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, P.S. Kotwali City, District Hardoi.
3. In terms of the FIR it was alleged that the sister of the informant was married to the son of the applicant on 20.05.2022 and sufficient dowry was also given.

sentences.text:
on 12 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/172864380/
1 informant was killed by the entire matrimonial family.
The name of the family members were indicated in the FIR.
In terms of the post-mortem report on record, the cause of death is shown as ante mortem hanging and apart from a ligature mark, no other injury was observed on the body.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant draws my attention to the statement of the mediator who feigned ignorance with regard to demand of dowry.
5. Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.

6. Considering the fact that in the statements, there is nothing specific so as to demonstrate that the applicant had subjected the victim to any physical or mental harassment in relation to demand of dowry coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal history, the applicant, who is in custody since 09.11.2023, is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
In view thereof, the application is allowed.
